name: Poslednee Leto
source:
Every story has an ending. Even the story of [url=/v3126]Beskonechnoe leto[/url], permeated with ellipses and question marks, must find its end.

This mod offers a clear and seamless continuation of the original story, a logical justification for the mysticism that surrounds it, and flashes out our familiar and beloved characters in the new final loop of the "Sovyonok" camp.
translation:
每个故事都有一个结局。即使是充满省略号和问号的 [url=/v3126]Beskonechnoe leto[/url] 故事，也必须找到结局。

这个模组提供了原始故事的清晰和无缝的延续，为围绕它的神秘主义提供了逻辑上的理由，并在“Sovyonok”阵营的新的最后循环中闪现出我们熟悉和喜爱的角色。
